text: Hello, this is Maya calling on behalf of Nexus Software. Am I speaking with the right person about your account?
Yes, that's me. What's this about?
Great! I'm calling to follow up on your subscription renewal. I noticed you've been with us for a while now, and I wanted to make sure everything is working well for you.
Yes, I've been happy with the service. Very stable and consistent. I like that nothing changes unexpectedly.
That's wonderful to hear. We do have a new feature package coming up. Would you like me to walk you through it step by step?
Sure, I appreciate when things are explained carefully. I prefer to understand all the details before I make any decisions.
Absolutely. The upgrade includes three new modules. Shall I send you a written summary as well?
Yes please, that would be perfect. I always like to have something in writing to review with my team.
